caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a decorative border, on which two human figures are riding horses. The plate’s background is a beige or tan color with a brownish hue, and the rim is outlined with a darker brown shade as well as a repeating diamond-pattern motif. The figures are dressed in green clothing with one of them wearing a hat, both facing towards the left side of the plate. The horses are rendered in brown and gray tones, with one horse shaded in solid brown and the other featuring striped black and white detailing. A tree with a brown trunk and green foliage is situated to the right of the riders inside the plate’s design. Along the lower edge of the plate is a wavy green pattern. The signature “E.H. Shortt” appears in the lower right corner, accompanied by the year “1938.” The overall composition is circular, with all elements contained within the boundary of the plate.
title: Pa. German Plate
